Tatlong lugar sa Caloocan na pawang mga complaint area ang sinuyod ng mga tauhan ng Northern Traffic Enforcement District (NTED) kaninang umaga para matiyak na walang iligal na nakaparada at walang anumang sagabal sa daan.

Nagkasa ng clearing operations ang grupo sa mga sumusunod na lugar: Brgy. 67 P. Sevilla., C. Cordero St., at kahabaan ng C3 Road Caloocan. Labimpito ang natiketan. 

Iwasan ang abala, sumunod sa batas trapiko para walang towing o pagmumulta. 

Para sa mga sagabal sa mga secondary roads at mas maliliit pang daan sa Metro Manila, makipag-ugnayan sa lokal na pamahalaan na sumasakop sa lugar para mag-report.

data.text:
Bangladeshi media reports that India is displacing rice exports for many countries like Thailand, Pakistan and Myanmar by flooding foreign markets with rice. 🇮🇳🌾

India had a record high rice harvest this year resulting in India overtaking China to become the world's largest rice producer.

There is so much excess rice in India now that producers are desperately looking for new markets like North Africa, Kuwait + Benin to buy the rice.

Philippines, the largest rice importer, has banned rice imports until April to boost domestic production.

Global rice prices are expected to fall by 10-15% in coming days due to the oversupply.

India is the world's largest rice exporter btw, 40%+ in FY 2025
